 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. In this story Jaylen Brown missed the Philadelphia 76ers' 98-93 win over the New York Knicks on the first night of NBA Cup play on Friday.
 Brown was listed on the team's injury report as out with a left patellar issue after initially being listed as questionable before being downgraded to doubtful on Friday afternoon. NBA reporter Marc Stein got a bit more specific, saying the veteran forward is dealing with left patellar tendinopathy , a repetitive use injury.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Both LeBron James and Joel Embiid were available for the Sixers with Friday's game being the first of a back-to-back. James scored 20 points with 8 rebounds and 7 assists, while Embiid finished with 10 points, 7 boards and 7 assists. No word yet on whether either will play Saturday's road game versus the Charlotte Hornets.
 Brown said he felt soreness in his left knee after Wednesday's 114-109 win over the Indiana Pacers and wasn't able to participate in Friday's shootaround, according to Sixers head coach Nick Nurse .
 In his first five games with the Sixers, Brown is averaging 20.6 points, 6.6 rebounds and 4.2 assists while shooting 41% on 22 3-point attempts.
 The 76ers won their season opener over the Knicks, defeating the reigning NBA champions at Madison Square Garden . Brown scored 19 points with 8 rebounds and 6 assists in the 106-100 win. Tyrese Maxey led all scorers with 28 points. Jalen Brunson was the Knicks' top scorer with 21 points, but shot 6 of 19.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement NBA Cup games played Oct. 30 through Dec. 11
 Philadelphia is in the East Group B division of the NBA Cup tournament with the Knicks, Pacers, Cleveland Cavaliers and Miami Heat. Each team will play four games in the group stage, one against each group opponent, with two games at home and two on the road.
 Each of the six group winners, plus two wild cards, will advance to the knockout rounds in an eight-team, three-round bracket that will crown a champion Dec. 11 in Indianapolis.
 The Sixers will play the Cavs on Nov. 6, the Heat on Nov. 25 and the Pacers on Nov. 27. The Knicks will next face the Pacers on Nov. 13, the Cavs on Nov. 25 and the Heat on Nov. 27.
